entities.summary: David Kellogg Lewis was an American philosopher. Lewis taught briefly at UCLA and then at Princeton University from 1970 until his death. He is closely associated with Australia, whose philosophical community he visited almost annually for more than 30 years. David Lewis was a philosophers & thinkers from Oberlin (1941-09-28, Oberlin–2001-10-14). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
